primary_meaning: A ceremonial observance that functions as a shadow or type pointing forward to the substance found in Christ

alternatives.meaning: New beginnings, renewal, or the start of a fresh cycle of time under God's ordering
basis: Astronomical fact of the lunar cycle beginning again

alternatives.meaning: Perpetual worship continuing into the new creation
A continuing obligatory observance for Christians
basis: Certain sabbatarian or Hebrew-roots readings of Colossians 2

notes: Colossians 2 supplies the dominant Christian typological reading that new-moon observances belong to the ceremonial shadows fulfilled in Christ; the renewal motif is also frequently invoked but is secondary and more homiletical than dogmatic. No single naturalistic or prophetic symbolism has achieved comparable consensus.
